meta.title: NOSTALGIA Map v2 - districts from real GHMC wards
meta.format: each district: wards (whole or part with the split rule), polys = [{outer, holes}] as [lat, lon] rings clipped to the A1 frame (lon 78.335-78.561, lat 17.312-17.475)
notes: Ward polygons are the 2009-delimitation GHMC wards (150; 145 present in the DataMeet layer, ward 3, 4, 11, 13, 113 missing). Ward names are administrative and do not always match the locality: e.g. Golconda Fort lies in Ward 66 Langar Houz, Tolichowki X Roads in Ward 94 Shaikpet, Mehdipatnam X Roads in Ward 69 Nanal Nagar, Koti and the Assembly in Ward 78 Gunfoundry, Charminar and the Salar Jung Museum in Ward 32 Patthergatti, the MGBS in Ward 30 Dabeerpura, Uppal X Roads in Ward 8 Habsiguda, LB Nagar in Ward 12 Mansoorabad.
Land without a GHMC ward (Secunderabad Cantonment, Begumpet airport, Osmania University campus, Mir Alam Tank, Nagole, outskirts) is given to districts as gap_* parts.
Splits of wards between game districts use simple latitude/longitude lines or the Musi centreline / Hussain Sagar shore band (rule in each ward entry).
attribution: Map reference: DataMeet Municipal Spatial Data (CC BY 4.0) and (c) OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)
